name: Renzik "The Shiv"
summary: Renzik "The Shiv" is a goblin operative and the trusted second-in-command of SI:7, stationed inside their headquarters in Stormwind City's Old Town. He serves Spymaster Mathias Shaw faithfully, directing new rogue recruits and handling covert operations where typical Alliance agents cannot tread.

sections.title: A Goblin in SI:7
sections.body: Renzik keeps the story of his past to himself. What Stormwind knows is that this goblin found his way into SI:7 and now stands as Spymaster Mathias Shaw's second in command. He has little taste for company, but the pay is good, and he values the respect his position brings; he counts himself one of the few goblins who can honestly say they are respected rather than simply feared.

sections.title: Right Hand of Mathias Shaw
sections.body: Now based inside the secretive SI:7 fortress in Old Town, Renzik serves as Mathias Shaw's second-in-command. Because most intelligence agents are humans, dwarves, or gnomes who immediately stand out in Kalimdor, Renzik's goblin heritage makes him an indispensable asset for infiltrating Orgrimmar and other Horde-held territories. Rogue mentors across the Alliance—from the Hidden Circle in Ironforge to shadow operatives in Darnassus—send their most promising agents to Renzik. Rather than sending them straight to slaughter, Renzik forwards them to field instructors like Lucius in Redridge to hone their survival craft.

faq.q: Why is a goblin working for Stormwind's SI:7?
aliases: why is there a goblin in si7
faq.answer: Renzik keeps the story of how he came to Stormwind to himself. He values the steady pay and genuine respect he earns among SI:7, taking pride in being respected rather than merely feared. His goblin face is also an asset: he can work in Orgrimmar and other Horde lands where human, dwarf, or gnome agents would stand out.
Renzik has never shared the story behind the name with Stormwind. The nickname is all anyone in Old Town gets, and for a spy that may be the point.

faq.q: What does Renzik do for player rogues?
faq.answer: When Alliance rogues prove their competence, their trainers send them to Renzik in Stormwind. He acts as their intake handler for SI:7, dispatching recruits to specialized trainers like Lucius in the Redridge Mountains to ensure they have the fieldcraft to stay alive.

He is stationed inside the SI:7 headquarters in Old Town, Stormwind City. In the broader scope of intelligence work, his goblin identity allows him to blend in and run espionage operations in places standard Alliance agents cannot go, such as Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Does Renzik maintain ties outside Stormwind?
faq.answer: Yes. Within the Alliance intelligence network, he coordinates with rogue contacts including the dwarven Hidden Circle in Ironforge and night elf operatives based in Darnassus, integrating shadow networks across both continents.

angles.text: For an Alliance rogue, Renzik is your bridge from street-level knifework into the high-stakes intelligence network of SI:7, weeding out the reckless before sending you to Lucius in Redridge.
Though a goblin, Renzik is one of Stormwind's most capable intelligence officers, managing operations in hostile territories where human spies would be caught on sight.
Standing beside Spymaster Shaw in Old Town, Renzik is a rare goblin fixture in the kingdom's military elite, proving that loyalty and competence outweigh race in the shadow wars.
